content: You will be given an essay and asked about to annotate a specified part from it. Choose the argumentative role of the given sentence from list 1.opp (opponent), 2.pro (proponent). Choose only one label.

Today I will delete my Facebook account. Not only because I'm constantly astonished about who wants to be my friend. I'm also tired of my data boosting the market value of that corporation. Facebook warns me emphatically that I may lose contact with my friends. And yet now I'll actually have all the more time for them.
What is the argumentative role of "And yet now I'll actually have all the more time for them." from the given essay? choose from 1. opp 2. pro
